snippet.title: Both Guards Point to the Lion 🦁 Riddle #2 Answer + Riddle #3: Who Broke the Vase? #shorts
snippet.description:
Riddle #2 solved: ask either guard "If I asked the other guard which door leads outside, which door would he point to?" Both point to the lion door, so you take the OTHER door.

Then Riddle #3: someone broke the old blue vase this morning, and it had been raining heavily since sunrise.
Person 1: "I was reading in the garden the whole time."
Person 2: "I was in the kitchen, baking bread."
Person 3: "I was asleep upstairs and woke up at the crash."

Who is lying? Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise 🌅

#riddle #logicpuzzle #brainteaser #mystery #shorts
